title: Hourglass Unlocked Defining and Lengthening Tubing Mascara
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Long-wearing✓ Gluten Free✓ Without Parabens✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Lengthening

What it is: A transformative tubing mascara that stretches each lash to deliver dramatic length and definition for the look of lash extensions in an instant.


Ingredient Callouts: Free of sulfates SLS and SLES, parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, triclosan, and contains less than one percent of synthetic fragrances. This product is also vegan, cruelty-free, and gluten-free.


What Else You Need to Know: This mascara is the ultimate formula for when more is more: more definition, more lift, and more length to transform lashes with impossibly real results. Using film-forming technology, it coats each lash in lightweight fibers for a high-impact,

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

- Starting at the base of the lashes, pull mascara brush straight through from root to tip. 

- One application provides an instant effect, but additional coats add intense definition, length, and lift. 

- For easy and gentle removal, splash warm water onto the eyes and use fingers to slide off the tube-like film from the lashes.

Ingredients+

Ultra Black:

Water/Aqua, Acrylates/Ethylhexyl Acrylate Copolymer, Alcohol Denat., Glyceryl Stearate, Glycerin, Dimethicone, Glyceryl Stearate Se, Vp/Eicosene Copolymer, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Copernicia Cerifera Cera, Stearic Acid, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Butylene Glycol, Camellia Japonica Flower Extract, Disodium Edta, Ethylhexylglycerin, Laureth-21, Methylglucamine, Myristic Acid, Palmitic Acid, Panthenol, Pvp, Tocopherol, Tromethamine, Xanthan Gum, Phenoxyethanol, Iron Oxides (Ci 77499), Ultramarines (Ci 77007).


Espresso:

Water/Aqua, Acrylates/Ethylhexyl Acrylate Copolymer, Alcohol Denat., Glyceryl Stearate, Glycerin, Dimethicone, Glyceryl Stearate Se, Vp/Eicosene Copolymer, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Copernicia Cerifera Cera, Stearic Acid, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Butylene Glycol, Camellia Japonica Flower Extract, Disodium Edta, Ethylhexylglycerin, Laureth-21, Methylglucamine, Myristic Acid, Palmitic Acid, Panthenol, Pvp, Tocopherol, Tromethamine, Xanthan Gum, Phenoxyethanol, Iron Oxides (ci 77491, ci 77492, ci 77499). 


*Ingredient lists and claims may change or vary from time to time as part of our commitment to innovation and maintaining global compliance. Please refer to the ingredient list on the product packaging you receive to ensure the ingredients are suitable for your personal use.
